title: Generic Override Configuration
description: Path-based overrides supporting both dot notation (for flat structures like 'ALQ_184.shortName') and bracket notation (for nested arrays like 'stations[3].munitions'). Supports both array operations ({ add: [...], remove: [...] }) and direct property updates.

add.description: Items to add to the array

remove.description: Items to remove from the array

oneOf.description: Direct property value (string, number, boolean, null, array, or object)

^.+\\.(([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*(\\[[0-9]+.description: Path-based override using dot notation or bracket notation (e.g., 'ALQ_184.shortName', 'stations[3].munitions', 'radios[0].name')
